transcript: Deep in the drawer of my father's desk I discovered an old diary He seems to have been writing for a long time I hesitated to open it For a moment I held my breath Reading it would mean entering the private world of my father's heart But I could not avoid the temptation I picked it up and began reading each line in his youth My father had been composing poetry In every word there was a joy in life But also a small regret at the bottom of his chest My father is always quiet and says little But inside that diary, another father existed I quietly returned the diary And closed the drawer Glimpsing my father's past Filled me with a new respect for him

segments.text: Deep in the drawer of my father's desk I discovered an old diary
He seems to have been writing for a long time
I hesitated to open it For a moment I held my breath
Reading it would mean entering the private world of my father's heart
But I could not avoid the temptation
I picked it up and began reading each line in his youth
My father had been composing poetry
In every word there was a joy in life
But also a small regret at the bottom of his chest
My father is always quiet and says little
But inside that diary, another father existed
Filled me with a new respect for him
